title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential corridors and commercial hubs surrounding Bryant University's Smithfield campus, from student-favorite eateries to major shopping centers.

cards.title: Parente's Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Douglas Pike (Route 7)
cards.notes: Visit this long-standing Bulldog staple located directly across from the main campus entrance for classic pub fare and a dedicated student atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential Bryant student hangout located on Douglas Pike, known for its proximity to campus and traditional American menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Parente's Restaurant is described as a 'staple for Bryant students' located 'just outside the university's main entrance' on Douglas Pike.
cards.source_title: Small town, big flavor: 10 must-try casual eateries in Smithfield, Rhode Island
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner; walkable from the main campus gate.

cards.title: Pick Pockets
cards.subtitle: George Washington Highway (Route 116)
cards.notes: Stop by this Mediterranean spot tucked inside a Mobil station for quick gyros and wraps, a popular choice for students on the go.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean eatery located on George Washington Highway known for its fresh wraps and convenient location near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Pick Pockets is identified as a Mediterranean shop located in the Mobil station on George Washington Highway, popular with the Bryant community.
cards.source_title: Small town, big flavor: 10 must-try casual eateries in Smithfield, Rhode Island
cards.access_notes: Located within the Mobil gas station; offers countertop seating and takeout.

cards.title: Brewology Cafe
cards.subtitle: Cedar Swamp Road
cards.notes: Head to this local cafe for specialty coffee and a quiet place to study away from the campus library.
cards.short_summary: A local coffee shop on Cedar Swamp Road providing a relaxed environment for students to study and caffeinate.
cards.evidence_claim: Brewology Cafe is located at 9 Cedar Swamp Road in Smithfield and serves as a local coffee and lounge destination.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; offers indoor seating and a drive-thru option.

cards.title: The Crossing at Smithfield
cards.subtitle: Putnam Pike (Route 44)
cards.notes: Visit this major outdoor shopping center for essentials at Target, Dave's Marketplace, or various national retail chains.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial hub for Bryant students, featuring a wide array of retail stores and dining options on Putnam Pike.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crossing at Smithfield is a 'bustling new shopping Plaza' located approximately 5 miles from the local village area, featuring anchors like Target and Dave's Marketplace.
cards.access_notes: Large outdoor mall with ample parking; accessible via RIPTA bus from campus.

cards.title: Blackbird Farm Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Douglas Pike (Route 7)
cards.notes: Browse local produce and handmade goods at this seasonal Sunday market located just over two miles from the university.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal farmers market on Douglas Pike offering fresh local goods to the Bryant and Smithfield community.
cards.evidence_claim: Blackbird Farm Farmers Market is located at 660 Douglas Pike, 2.3 miles from campus, and runs on Sundays through early October.
cards.source_title: Beyond Bryant: 7 Smithfield-based activities for Bulldogs
cards.access_notes: Open Sundays 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. during the season (weather permitting).

cards.title: Wing Power
cards.subtitle: Sanderson Road
cards.notes: Join fellow students for weekly music bingo or trivia nights at this casual eatery located a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular spot for student social events like trivia and music bingo, located on Sanderson Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Wing Power at 5 Sanderson Road holds trivia every Tuesday and music bingo every Thursday at 6:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Beyond Bryant: 7 Smithfield-based activities for Bulldogs
cards.access_notes: Casual dining environment; check their schedule for specific event nights.

cards.title: Pleasant View Orchards
cards.subtitle: Pleasant View Avenue
cards.notes: Experience a classic New England tradition by visiting this family-owned farm stand for fresh apples and baked goods.
cards.short_summary: A historic farm stand on Pleasant View Avenue offering seasonal local products and a taste of Smithfield's rural roots.
cards.evidence_claim: Pleasant View Orchards is a family-owned farm stand in Smithfield offering fresh fruits and baked goods since 1968.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal hours; typically open daily during the harvest season.

cards.title: Blackie's
cards.subtitle: George Washington Highway (Route 116)
cards.notes: Dine at this award-winning restaurant known for its creative menu and extensive gluten-free options, located just minutes from Bryant.
cards.short_summary: A highly-rated local restaurant on George Washington Highway popular for its unique dishes and inclusive menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Blackie's is located at 280 George Washington Hwy and is noted for its scratch-made menu and 'best burger' awards.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday; reservations are often recommended.

cards.title: Little Dave's
cards.subtitle: Cedar Swamp Road
cards.notes: Shop for fresh groceries at this nostalgic, smaller version of the local Dave's Fresh Marketplace chain.
cards.short_summary: A compact, high-quality grocery store on Cedar Swamp Road known affectionately as 'Little Smithfield'.
cards.evidence_claim: Dave's Fresh Marketplace at 4 Cedar Swamp Road is known as 'Little Smithfield' and has been a local fixture since 1977.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; smaller footprint than the Smithfield Crossings location.

cards.title: Apple Valley Mall
cards.subtitle: Putnam Pike (Route 44)
cards.notes: Access essential services like CVS and various local shops at this established commercial center on the Greenville side of town.
cards.short_summary: A traditional shopping plaza on Putnam Pike providing everyday services and retail for the Smithfield community.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Valley Mall is listed as a key shopping center in Smithfield, containing a CVS and other retail services.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; located in the Greenville village area of Smithfield.
